## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2021-12-21: Business Combination Agreement signed between Zanite, EVE UAM LLC, Embraer S.A., and EAH; 8-K describes contemplated 75% TRA with EAH
- 2022-04-13: DEFM14A files form-of TRA inline as Annex O
- 2022-05-09: Business combination closes; Zanite renamed Eve Holding, Inc.; TRA executed between Eve Holding and EAH
- 2022-05-13: Closing 8-K filed; executed TRA filed as Ex 10.3, Tax Sharing Agreement as Ex 10.4

#### Deconsolidation and TRA effectuation

- 2025-08-13: Registered Direct Offering drops Embraer below 80% ownership; Eve deconsolidates from EAH's U.S. federal tax group; Tax Sharing Agreement terminates and TRA becomes economically active
- 2026-02 (FY2025 10-K): Confirms deconsolidation and TRA effectuation; pre-deconsolidation NOLs written off; TSA off-book register of accumulated tax benefits available to offset future TRA payments; no TRA liability recorded

## Explanation

Eve Holding executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the May 9, 2022 close of the SPAC business combination between Zanite Acquisition Corp. and Embraer's eVTOL subsidiary EVE UAM, LLC; the contract is a two-party direct TRA with Embraer Aircraft Holding, Inc. (the controlling shareholder) rather than the typical Up-C multi-counterparty structure. The TRA pays EAH 75% of net cash tax savings (PubCo retains 25%) from basis step-ups in UAM Business assets created in the Pre-Closing Restructuring, plus tax benefits attributable to entering the TRA and to TRA payments themselves; no NOLs are covered. The contract was contractually in force from May 9, 2022 but economically dormant while EAH held at least 80% of Eve Holding and a parallel Tax Sharing Agreement controlled inter-company tax allocation. On August 13, 2025 a Registered Direct Offering dropped Embraer below the 80% threshold, triggering U.S. federal tax deconsolidation under Section 1504, terminating the Tax Sharing Agreement, and effectuating the TRA. No TRA liability is recorded under ASC 450 because Eve's pre-deconsolidation NOLs were utilized at the consolidated level and the TSA off-book register of accumulated tax benefits previously generated by Eve is available to offset future TRA payments. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the 2025-08-13 coverage gap note.
